confirm.withDigest: Confirm places the booking. The artist sees it in the app right away. The confirmation email goes out in the daily summary at {{time}}.
confirm.appOnly: Confirm places the booking and notifies the artist in the app right away.

accept.holdDescription: Hold placed. Your producer confirms next.

actionCopy.softBookedMeaning: Accepted the offer. Held for you, not booked, until you confirm.
actionCopy.tierConceptNote: Tiers are your casts in priority order. Offers open with tier 1. If it cannot fill, you open the next tier.
actionCopy.dateSourceNote: You can add a show date by hand here. If your workspace syncs from Airtable, those dates keep updating on their own, and a date you add here is not changed by a sync.
actionCopy.unrestrictedEligibility: This date has no cast limits, so anyone in {{org}} can be booked here.

cancel.title: Cancel {{artist}}'s booking?
cancel.understudyLine: If {{artist}} is in the main cast, the longest waiting accepted understudy is promoted automatically.
cancel.whoHearsFallback: The artist is notified in the app.
